article_title: I'm 12 and want to try protein powder - should I?

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main conclusion about protein powder for healthy teenagers?
options: Most healthy teenagers can obtain enough protein from a balanced diet and should seek expert advice before using powders.
Every teenager needs a protein shake after exercise.
Protein powder is safer than ordinary food for children.
Teenagers should replace one meal a day with a supplement.
tasks.correct_answer: Most healthy teenagers can obtain enough protein from a balanced diet and should seek expert advice before using powders.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המסקנה היא שבני נוער בריאים שאוכלים תזונה מאוזנת יכולים לקבל את החלבון מהמזון, ומומלץ להתייעץ עם איש מקצוע לפני אבקה.

tasks.prompt: What happens to proteins after we eat them?
options: They immediately turn into body fat.
They are stored unchanged in the muscles.
They break down into amino acids used for growth and repair.
They replace calcium and iron in the blood.
tasks.correct_answer: They break down into amino acids used for growth and repair.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: חלבונים מתפרקים לחומצות אמינו המסייעות לגוף לגדול ולתקן רקמות.

tasks.prompt: What does “reputable” mean when the article describes supplement companies?
options: Known to be reliable and trustworthy
Able to make the cheapest product
Popular only on social media
Required to sell medicine
tasks.correct_answer: Known to be reliable and trustworthy
tasks.explanation_hebrew: reputable פירושו בעל מוניטין אמין; חברות כאלה עשויות לבצע בדיקות חיצוניות כדי לוודא שהתווית תואמת לתכולה.

tasks.prompt: Which group might sometimes find protein shakes or powders useful, according to the dietitian?
options: Children who dislike vegetables
Anyone who wants larger muscles immediately
All pupils before school
High-level athletes or people with certain allergies
tasks.correct_answer: High-level athletes or people with certain allergies
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדיאטנית מציינת שספורטאי עילית או אנשים עם אלרגיות מסוימות עשויים להפיק תועלת, אך התוספים אינם תחליף לתזונה בריאה.

tasks.prompt: Why does the dietitian warn teenage girls not to focus too narrowly on protein?
options: A narrow focus may cause them to neglect nutrients such as iron and calcium.
Protein is never needed during puberty.
Only boys can digest amino acids.
Iron and calcium are found only in protein powders.
tasks.correct_answer: A narrow focus may cause them to neglect nutrients such as iron and calcium.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התמקדות יתר בחלבון עלולה לבוא על חשבון רכיבים חיוניים אחרים, ובמיוחד ברזל וסידן.

tasks.prompt: What does “not as tightly regulated as medicines” mean?
options: Protein powders are prescribed in every hospital.
Supplements face less strict control and checking than medicines.
Medicines and powders follow exactly the same rules.
Protein powder can be sold only by doctors.
tasks.correct_answer: Supplements face less strict control and checking than medicines.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכוונה היא ששוק האבקות נתון לפיקוח ולבדיקות פחות מחמירים מתרופות, ולכן התווית לא תמיד משקפת במדויק את התכולה.

tasks.prompt: What risks or unwanted effects of protein powder are identified in the article?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין תופעות עיכול, סוכר או מרכיבים מלאכותיים וממריצים מוסתרים, פיקוח מוגבל, וסיכון לעומס על הכליות והכבד בצריכת יתר.
expected_points: Possible side effects include bloating, gas, cramps and diarrhoea.
Some powders contain added sugar, artificial ingredients or hidden stimulants.
The market is not regulated as strictly as medicines, so labels may not always match contents.
Excess protein must be excreted and can overload the kidneys and liver.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the experts' advice to teenagers who want more protein.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול תזונה מאוזנת ומזון רגיל תחילה, פיזור החלבון לאורך היום, אי־החלפת ארוחות, והתייעצות מקצועית לפני שימוש קבוע.
expected_points: Most teenagers can meet their protein needs through ordinary food.
Protein intake should be spread across the day rather than concentrated in one shake.
Supplements should not replace balanced meals containing micronutrients.
Improve the diet first and consult a registered dietitian or nutritionist before regular powder use.

tasks.prompt: Why is the claim that a protein shake alone will make muscles grow misleading?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שבניית שריר תלויה באימון, תזונה כוללת, גדילה והתאוששות; הגוף מסוגל לנצל כמות מוגבלת בלבד ותוספים אינם מספקים את כל הרכיבים.
expected_points: Protein supplies amino acids but does not replace exercise and recovery.
A balanced diet provides energy and micronutrients needed for healthy growth.
The body can handle only a limited amount of protein and must excrete excess.
A supplement is useful only in particular circumstances and does not automatically enlarge muscles.

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced reply to a healthy 12-year-old asking to use protein powder.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להכיר ברצון להתחזק, להסביר שמזון מאוזן בדרך כלל מספיק, להזכיר סיכונים ותופעות לוואי, ולהמליץ על התייעצות עם דיאטנית או רופא.
expected_points: Acknowledge the young person's interest in sport and strength.
Explain that a healthy balanced diet normally supplies enough protein at this age.
Mention that powders can have side effects, variable ingredients and risks when overused.
Recommend improving food choices first and consulting a registered professional if concerns remain.
